naslov: AI Wars Ep. 8: Anthropic cuts IPO price, DeepSeek undercuts OpenAI
opis:
Anthropic isn't delaying its IPO despite the tech selloff. It's targeting a valuation of $1.25 to $1.75 trillion, below the $2 trillion that had been floated, and wants to raise $80 to $100 billion before Thanksgiving, with annual revenue already past $80 billion. naslov: Cloudflare security-audit skill: turn your coding agent into a security auditor | AI Tool #9
opis:
A skill for coding agents that turns the agent into a security auditor. It runs several separate agents through phases: reconnaissance, hunting for holes, verifying candidates and writing the report. Cloudflare's internal vulnerability-hunting system grew out of it.

How to try it:
1. You need Node.js and an agent with a model that supports tools and parallel subagents (e.g. Claude Code).
2. In the terminal, run: npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit (add --global to install at the user level).
3. Start the agent in your project and type something like "security audit this codebase" or "find security vulnerabilities in ./src".
4. The report goes to ~/security-audit-skill/<repo-name>/run-<N> unless you set a different path. Run npx skills --help to check whether your agent is supported.

Price: free (MIT), you only pay for model tokens

Official link: https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill

naslov: What is fine-tuning? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
Fine-tuning means giving an AI model that's already trained some extra training on a smaller, focused set of examples. This teaches it a new skill or habit without building it from scratch. Example: Nous Research fine-tuned Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B on about 53 million tokens. By their own tests, the share of propaganda answers fell from 22% to about 1%, and the model's general skills stayed the same.
